point_in_time_reading.cannot_discriminate: next-earnings date and time: equal to the final event in every sample event (no moved event in the sample), so hindsight and as-of knowledge look identical
point_in_time_reading.class: DATED_NOT_STAMPED / RECONSTRUCTED_AS_OF_UNVERIFIED for the option-derived fields
point_in_time_reading.not_verifiable: skew label, iv_rank, iv_percentile, iv30, implied move: option-derived, no per-row timestamp, no independent record; market.vix is null with missing_periscope=true for all rows, which suggests the historical record is reconstructed rather than a stored live snapshot
point_in_time_reading.verified_as_of: realized volatility (rv): equals the 21-log-return volatility ending exactly on the requested date for every event, and only the window ending on that date reproduces it exactly (shifted windows deviate: median 1.3-1.5 % at +-1 session, 4-8 % at +-3); the saved candle closes are also the closes the provider used then (no later adjustment visible for these 40 events)
